formulas.scope_1.vehicle: annual_km x (L per 100 km / 100) x fuel factor (kg CO2e/L)
formulas.scope_1.fuel_total: litres per year x fuel factor (kg CO2e/L)
formulas.scope_1.dg_set: run hours per year x litres per hour x fuel factor
formulas.scope_2.electricity: kWh per year x grid factor (kg CO2e/kWh), location-based, one all-India factor
formulas.scope_3.hardware: device count x embodied-carbon factor per device per year
formulas.scope_3.commute: one-way km x 2 (return trip) x 250 working days x employees x mode share x mode factor
formulas.scope_3.waste: kg per year x waste factor for that category and disposal route
formulas.scope_3.cloud: GPU hours x cloud GPU factor
formulas.confidence: full data ±10%, partial ±25%, totals only ±40%, missing ±50%; total range is the sum of scope ranges

scope_1.vehicles: Company-owned or leased vehicles: fuel logs, fleet km, fuel cards
scope_1.dg_set: Diesel generators: run-hour logs, diesel purchases for backup power
scope_1.fuel_total: Any other fuel burnt on site: LPG/PNG for canteens, boilers
scope_1.refrigerants: AC/chiller gas top-ups (HFCs). No factor in this calculator: flag, do not calculate

scope_2.energy_meter: Purchased grid electricity: meter readings, electricity bills (kWh)

scope_3.cloud: Cloud compute bills, GPU hours (Cat. 1 purchased services)
scope_3.hardware: Laptops, desktops, servers, GPUs bought (Cat. 2 capital goods)
scope_3.commute: Staff travel between home and work: commute surveys (Cat. 7)
scope_3.waste: Solid waste, e-waste, wastewater from vendor logs (Cat. 5)
scope_3.business_travel: Flights, trains, hotels for work (Cat. 6). Not calculated here: flag
scope_3.purchased_goods: Other purchases (Cat. 1). Not calculated here: flag

categories.out_of_scope: Personal spending, revenue, salaries, anything that is not an emission activity

grading.basis: Graded on intensity, not size. Organisations: t CO2e per employee per year, A < 0.8, B < 1.5, C < 2.5, D < 4.0, F >= 4.0. Individuals: t per person against India's per-capita figure (~2.0 t, approximate), A < 0.5x, B < 1x, C < 1.5x, D < 2x. Reference point: TCS FY26 disclosed Scope 1+2+3 = 914,687 t over 580,000 employees = 1.58 t/employee. Organisations without a headcount are not graded.

report_template.contents: Total t CO2e, range, intensity per employee, grade and grade basis
Measured sources, estimated sources, formula, inputs, result, confidence
kWh, grid factor, location-based result, renewable share if known
Each category: measured, estimated or illustrative, with formula and inputs
Every assumed value: what, why, formula, effect on the total, how to replace it
Energy use, fuel use, waste by type, intensity, data quality mix
Ranked actions with t saved, cost, payback; what to change and where
Every factor with its source, year and status (sourced or illustrative)

rules: Never invent a source. Factors marked illustrative_assumption must be called illustrative.
Never override uploaded data; only fill fields that are missing.
Every estimated value needs a one-sentence assumption with the reasoning and the numbers used.
Use India-specific, mid-range defaults. Be conservative.
If something cannot be calculated with these factors, say so instead of guessing a number.
